item.headline: China’s Spies Set Sights on A.I. Chips Years Before Nvidia Scandal
item.summary: China’s espionage agency has been running a secret campaign to help the country’s companies acquire advanced A.I. chips and to gather intelligence on the sector, officials say.
item.author: Chris Buckley and Julian E. Barnes

reads.result: China's spy agency has been secretly helping Chinese companies get advanced A.I. chips and gathering intelligence on the industry, officials say.
